start.title: [TODO:fr] One Last Word
start.text:
[TODO:fr] The Lord speaks at dusk in Goshen.
A final sign will free His people.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] His word is not yours to weigh.
[TODO:fr] You bow your head and listen.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Hide His word from the people
choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] It must be told to all.

argue_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Do Not Argue
argue_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] He has set the hour Himself.
Receive what He commands.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Speak It to All
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] His word is for every household.
Do not keep it to yourself.

gather_elders.title: [TODO:fr] Aaron at Your Side
gather_elders.text:
[TODO:fr] Aaron waits, the elders behind him.
What must each household do?

any_animal_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Without Blemish
any_animal_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Not any beast. The Lord chose this.
Obey His word exactly.

lamb_chosen.title: [TODO:fr] On the Fourteenth Day
lamb_chosen.text:
[TODO:fr] The lamb is kept until twilight.
Then all Israel slays it together.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Pour the blood on the ground

hide_blood_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Show the Sign
hide_blood_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] It is the sign He looks for.
Do not hide what He commanded.

ground_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] On the Doorframe
ground_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Lintel and side posts, He said.
That is where the sign must rest.

doorposts_marked.title: [TODO:fr] The Sign on Every Door
doorposts_marked.text:
[TODO:fr] Red marks the wood of every home.
Now the meal must be prepared.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Roast the lamb with bitter herbs

boil_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] As He Commanded
boil_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Roasted by fire. No leaven tonight.
Do it the way He spoke.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Roast the lamb with bitter herbs

meal_prepared.title: [TODO:fr] Eat in Haste
meal_prepared.text:
[TODO:fr] Loins girded. Sandals on. Staff in hand.
Ready to leave at His word.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Sit at ease, take your time

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] The door is shut behind you.

ease_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Be Ready
ease_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Tonight you eat as travelers.
Ready to rise and go.

wander_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Stay Within
wander_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] The blood guards only those inside.
Do not step beyond the door.

stay_inside.title: [TODO:fr] Midnight
stay_inside.text:
[TODO:fr] A great cry rises from Egypt.
In Goshen, only silence.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] Open the door to look out

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] It is His mercy, not yours.
[TODO:fr] The lamps burn low and warm.

open_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Wait on Him
open_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] The Lord passes over tonight.
Do not break the watch.

boast_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] His Mercy, Not Yours
boast_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] It is the blood that spares you.
Not your hand, not your name.

morning_summons.title: [TODO:fr] Pharaoh's Messengers
morning_summons.text:
[TODO:fr] Before dawn they pound your door.
The king himself summons you now.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You walk into the still city.

refuse_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] The Hour Has Come
refuse_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] He calls. Do not turn aside.
This is the moment promised.

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] You take the road to the palace.

before_broken_pharaoh.title: [TODO:fr] "Go. Serve the Lord."
before_broken_pharaoh.text:
[TODO:fr] Pharaoh stands hollow with grief.
"Take your flocks. Leave my land."

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] Do not strike a broken man.

Receive his word and go.
